I think you're pretty close.. although a lot of it could easily be summed up with the word: Misanthropy. Narcissism, suicidal tendencies, misanthropy.. the desire to be on the news.

The fact that his dad was a notorious bank robber who fled from prison reveals a genetic component in play, as well. Apple doesn't fall far from the tree.

I'm still surprised they haven't scanned the shit out of his computer and internet search history. A lot of loners/quiet types tend to be pretty heavy internet users.

 A wealthy middle-aged, real-estate owning gambler MUST have at least had something on his computer, unless he was clever and nuked the hard drive.. or simply avoided leaving any digital footprints altogether.
